runtimeClosure.applicationSources: Only the hashed solver files in source-lock.json and the new benchmark adapters/header; no external upstream app/main, data files, test corpus, books, oracle or repository research code is compiled or copied into the prepared closure
runtimeClosure.christopheExternalDependencies: C++ standard library, Windows SDK and Advapi32; static MSVC CRT. Native OS helpers are the pinned upstream implementation
runtimeClosure.ponsExternalDependencies: C++ standard library and system runtime; static GCC linkage
runtimeClosure.loadPathAudit: c4 Solver constructor calls both table loaders, whose if-constexpr false branches return before opening files; Writer construction returns before starting its file thread when UPDATE_TABLE_FILE=false. All three flags are compile-time asserted false in the adapter. Pons book construction sets T=null and depth=-1; its adapter never calls loadBook and checks both fields before solve
runtimeClosure.embeddedAnswerDataAttestation: The prior audited source closure is pinned by exact per-file hashes; include and file-load call sites plus current adapters/settings/constructors were rechecked. No answer data, root/prefix solution constant, book or persisted cache is introduced by these changes. This extends the pinned audit and does not claim historically blind algorithm discovery
runtimeClosure.freshness: One new process per run; complete allocated c4 table emptiness scan, complete Pons key/value zero scan; native node counters zero before solve; no separate proof cache

scheduling.christophe: Upstream pool runs all six workers and cancels/waits/merges after a result. mt19937 seed equals worker ID 0..5; scheduling and TT sharing make parallel work/time nondeterministic
scheduling.pons: Serial deterministic algorithm, no RNG; fresh TT every process
scheduling.repetitions: Operator serializes repeated fresh-process runs; report min/median/max and all raw records, never treat one parallel node count as invariant

workMetricDefinitions.christophe: Stats::new_node called at Search::negamax entry before stop check; merged across native workers and search iterations. Static-search child conclusions need not enter negamax
workMetricDefinitions.pons: nodeCount incremented at Solver::negamax entry; solve immediate-win path does not enter negamax
workMetricDefinitions.isomaxDiagnostic: Separate private copy counts selected worker negamax entries including cancellation checks; missing worker counts stay null

targetDifference: The common timing target is exact WDL. IsoMax also emits a legal value-preserving witness in its normal result; native wrappers do not request best-move or PV follow-up searches. Witness qualification is handled separately
scope: Preparation and bounded private diagnostics; no search algorithm changes, production runtime changes, source promotion, external communications or PR
historicalPrepareOnlyEvidence: historical-pre-boundary-* records bind earlier adapter executable hashes; current revised adapters are build-verified and will exercise their READY checks in serialized full runs
